highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.116.0 is the first stable v3 release, bringing modern .NET, Skia, and cross-platform view updates.
highlights_body: It rolls up the v3 preview work with API additions, WebAssembly improvements, refreshed native components, and fixes across supported UI platforms.

breaking.title: Legacy obsolete APIs were removed
breaking.body: Members previously marked obsolete are no longer available in v3. Update code to the documented replacement APIs before upgrading.

bullets.detail: The stable v3 release includes refreshed graphics and text-shaping engines.
New span-based overloads and picture-recording capabilities make common managed drawing scenarios more efficient and expressive.
v3 improves WebAssembly support and adds or refines view integrations across desktop and mobile platforms.

preview_summaries.v3.116.0-preview.6.1: The release preview completed the stabilization work for SkiaSharp v3.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.5.4: Preview 5 completed the v3 API and dependency refresh work.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.4.1: Preview 4 expanded rendering and platform compatibility.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added API refinements and native build updates.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 focused on modern .NET and view integration.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.1.8: Preview 1 opened the SkiaSharp v3 line.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.0 ships with the v3 release and updates the bundled text-shaping stack.
